description: This file defines the 'Coroutine' class, which provides functionality for running generator-based asynchronous code as promises within the GuzzleHttpomise namespace. It allows coroutines to be created, managed, and resolved, simplifying sequential async operations.

classes.name: Coroutine
classes.description: A class that manages generator-based asynchronous tasks, returning a promise that fulfills upon generator completion, inspired by async/await patterns.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Coroutine with a generator function, starting execution and handling promise resolution.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a Coroutine instance from a generator function.

methods.name: then
methods.description: Registers fulfillment and rejection handlers to the underlying promise.

methods.name: otherwise
methods.description: Registers a rejection handler to the underlying promise.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Blocks until the promise settles and returns the final value.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the promise ('pending', 'fulfilled', 'rejected').

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves the promise with a given value.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Rejects the promise with a given reason.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the current promise and marks the coroutine as canceled.

methods.name: nextCoroutine
methods.description: Proceeds to the next step in the generator by converting yielded value into a promise and attaching success/failure handlers.

methods._handleSuccess: Handles successful resolution of yielded promises, sending value into generator or resolving final promise.

methods._handleFailure: Handles promise rejection, throwing exception into generator and continuing or rejecting final promise.
